name: EPIC 206362356
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 9.9 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206362356 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.9312 (16th-84th percentiles 9.526997-10.457027), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,241 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.93 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,642 K at its surface.
